en: The Praise of Vajrasattva. Then indeed, all the Blessed Tathāgatas praised the Blessed Mahāvajrasattva:
"You are the nature of Mohavajra, Yamāri, most terrifying."
Consisting of all Buddhas, peaceful, O Vajra Body, homage be to you! || 1 ||
You are of the nature of Piśunavajra, Yamāri, most terrifying;
resembling Cittavajra, O Ratnavajra, homage be to you! (2)
You are the nature of passion-vajra, Yamāri, most terrifying;
O supreme among all sounds, foremost of the excellent, homage be to you, Vāgvajra! (3)
You are the very nature of the Vajra of Envy, Yamāri, most terrifying;
resembling the Body-Vajra, O you who hold a sword in hand, homage be to you! (4)
You are the self-nature of all Buddhas, the singular synthesis of all Buddhas;
O supreme among the most excellent of all Buddhas, Lord of the Maṇḍala, homage be to you! (5)
The Praise of the Glorious Mahāvajrasattva is completed.
